# Native PowerPoint test fixtures

These files are deterministic OOXML packages generated by
`generate-fixtures.mjs`. They are committed so automated tests use real binary
Office files rather than mocks.

## Decks

- `features.pptx`, `features.ppsx`, and `features.potx` include notes, a theme,
  an image, a hyperlink, a chart, a table, grouped shapes, a timing node, and an
  unknown custom OOXML part.
- `simple-edit.pptx` is a supported-shape editing fixture.
- `macro-view-only.*` include an inert `vbaProject.bin` payload. They test that
  macro-enabled files remain view-only and that untouched macro bytes survive a
  renderer round trip. They do not contain executable VBA.
- `large-deck.pptx` contains 160 slides.
- `malformed-*` cover random bytes, truncation, path traversal, and duplicate ZIP
  entries.

## DOCX

- `docx/table-cell-direct-24pt-font.docx` is a table-font regression fixture.
  Its document defaults are 11 pt, while every table-cell run is directly
  formatted at 24 pt (`w:sz="48"` and `w:szCs="48"`). If opening or saving the
  file strips direct cell-run formatting, affected cells visibly fall back to the
  small default text size.
- `lorem-ipsum.docx` and `lorem-ipsum.pptx` contain only inert Lorem Ipsum text.
  They are the sanitized publication fixtures for the DOCX and PowerPoint editor
  screenshots.

Regenerate the files with `npm run test:update-fixtures`.
